_comment: D5-44 (Cycle 11): casing-convention ratchet baseline for scripts/validate-subagent-casing.ts. Each entry is a pre-existing count of 'Sub-Agent' Title-Case + closed-form 'subagent(s)' violations (content-authoring rule 11) in a canonical content file. The gate FAILS on any NEW violating file or any count INCREASE; it accepts a count at-or-below the recorded value. Drive each entry to 0 and delete the row as the owning unit normalizes its file; the gate becomes zero-tolerance once this map is empty. RE-BASELINED 2026-07-12 (Cycle 12, D5-SA5.8-03): after adding the numbered-label carve-out to validate-subagent-casing.ts (`Sub-Agent N` / `Sub-Agents N-M` numbered proper-noun labels are no longer flagged), counts were re-measured against the current tree, drawing the ratchet down from 55 files / 136 violations to 43 files / 91 violations (project-spec 18->1, codebase-map 10->1, 12 files cleared; 0 new/regressed). The residual entries are genuine Title-Case / closed-form prose spellings still awaiting a lowercase rewrite by the owning unit.
